thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: High streaming error rate for tenant AventisPay (vpc: vpca-9f3). 5xx spike on gateway -> 45% of streaming sessions failing in last 3m. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-failures>

sanjeev: paging oncall, I'm taking primary.

claire: joining — quick q: which endpoints are impacted?

marta (AventisPay PM): production traffic — `checkout-stream` and `invoice-stream`. Customers see stalled websocket/SSE and their app gateway is aggressively retrying.

ryan: quick triage: gateway retry storm -> we see `503` from our tenant proxy and `RST` on connections. Likely connection throttling at the dedicated pool level causing cascading retries.

sanjeev: can we isolate the tenant to reduce blast radius? they're on `dedicated-gpupool-a1`.

ryan: yes. immediate mitigation options: lower `max_concurrent_streams` for that pool to reduce memory/queue pressure, enable `prefer_long_poll_fallback` for that tenant, and apply per-tenant ingress pacing.

claire: command to apply?

ryan: run: ```bash
curl -XPOST https://control-plane.internal/api/pools/update -d '{"pool":"dedicated-gpupool-a1","max_concurrent_streams":2}'
```
and: ```bash
rbctl apply --tenant aventispay --set prefer_long_poll_fallback=true
rbctl apply --tenant aventispay --set per_tenant_stream_rate=10/m
```

sanjeev: applying now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: config update job 9876 started for `dedicated-gpupool-a1`.

marta (AventisPay PM): will that cause reconnect storms? many mobile clients — need graceful transitions.

claire: good call. set `keepalive_interval=15s` and `graceful_drain=30s` on pool to reduce abrupt disconnects.

ryan: also adding edge limit: `per_tenant_stream_concurrency=10` at app gateway to throttle retries on their side.

sanjeev: update rolled. Monitoring: `aventispay.stream_failed_pct` trending down 45% -> 12% in ~6m.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager cleared (severity downgraded). Please annotate incident timeline.

marta (AventisPay PM): seeing reconnects but UX improves, still occasional retries logged from their gateway (backoff missing).

claire: follow-ups: 1) add guidance to our enterprise integration docs re: gateway retry backoff and keepalive; 2) run a config validation to detect pools without graceful drain; 3) schedule incident postmortem with AventisPay. I'll open the ticket.

sanjeev: oncall handoff to claire in 40m. marking incident as mitigated, creating incident card: `INC-2024-AVP-178`. Assigning follow-ups to `eng-integration` and `customer-success`.

ryan: I'll bake a short-lived dashboard for `aventispay_stream_errors`, `pool_queue_depth`, and `pool_max_concurrency` and keep watch for 2 hours.

marta (AventisPay PM): thanks everyone :pray: please share the postmortem notes and any suggested gateway config.

sanjeev: closing handoff — ping me if any regressions.
